note: Contract to Figma map for the Agentic DS file. Property keys are exact, including the #id suffix. Nothing here was guessed: a contract value with no Figma value is listed under noFigma. slots.childProps names the contract whose properties each array item sets on the exposed child instance; slots.show lists the Figma boolean per extra index. slots.child is a path to the layer a row sets: segments split on >, where @N is the Nth child, $column is the column's own layer name from slots.columns.layers, and N and R in a name are the column and row numbers. partLayers is the path to the instance Figma exposes inside an artboard part. frameLayers is the path to a part of the shell itself, such as the page header it draws over the page slot. A props.<name>.swap block says what an instanceSwap slot ships with: the component set it swaps in, and the roster of parts that component draws. A props.<name> of kind glyph names the layer holding the nested Icon instance and the swap property on it; the glyph itself comes from the top-level glyphs roster, read from the Icon set's preferred values. patterns.<Pattern>.regions.<region> says how that pattern lays a region out when it is not one column: columns is how many across, gap the variable between them. partVariants.<slot> is for a row of parts the artboard draws in one variant rather than one switch at a time: prop and value are the variant to ask for, count how many parts that variant draws. slots.<name>.childKeys holds the keys the parent exposes for each child, where they differ from the child's own: a Card says title#189:21 on its own and title#176:0 inside a Scoreboard. slots.<name>.childDivider is the boolean that draws the line between one child and the next: every child but the last shown one has it on.
